# ImpexLink

ImpexLink is the private inventory, purchasing, project, logistics, and client-order management application for Impex Engineering and Industrial Supply.

## Public entry points

- [ImpexLink application](https://impexengineering.org/): Sign in or register for the application.
- [Client registration](https://impexengineering.org/#/register): Create a client account.

## Product scope

Authenticated users use ImpexLink to manage inventory, projects, material requests, client orders, purchase orders, deliveries, payments, notifications, messages, and audit logs. Access is role-based; private records and operational data require an authorized account.

## Support and access

- [Sign in](https://impexengineering.org/#/login): Existing user access.
- [Registration](https://impexengineering.org/#/register): Client account registration.
